summary.text: Krista Knudsen is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 5A, in office since 2023, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Democrat Dan Mitchell is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Krista Knudsen lives in Lake Shore, Minnesota, and earned a B.S. in alcohol and drug studies and a B.S. in social work, both from Minnesota State University, Mankato.
Her career experience includes working as a restaurant owner, and she served on the Lake Shore City Council for eight years before becoming mayor of Lake Shore.
Krista Knudsen defeated Brian Hobson in the November 5, 2024 general election.
Knudsen's 2025-2026 committee assignments included the Education Finance Committee, the Health Finance and Policy Committee and the Human Services Finance and Policy Committee.
